title: HF534 (2025-2026 Regular): Permissible methods of submitting an application for a permit to carry a handgun expanded.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-02-11; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/HF/534/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version. The bill strikes the word "must" before "be submitted in person" and replaces it with "may", adding the other methods.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3): (e) Applications may be submitted in person, electronically, or by facsimile, certified mail, or certified delivery.
